app.notes:
Melody works on every MIDI song: 100 plays the melody as the song has it, each step down is quieter, and 0 or Guide off takes it out
Before, the level was set against full volume, so in songs with a quiet melody most settings were louder than the song itself and 100 was quieter than 60
Songs that play the melody on a second part too now turn both down together
Find lyrics online fits timed lyrics to MIDI and KAR songs by itself when they match, and saves them; if they do not match, you tap along once as before
